Who We Are

## What We Build

DevEraXTech is a web design and development studio based in Cairo , Egypt , founded in 2024 by Karim Ahmed and Loay Mohamed. We are a focused product and engineering team delivering premium digital platforms with disciplined execution, and we have shipped 10+ projects for clients in Egypt, the Gulf and North America.

Our work balances modern product design with robust implementation to help ambitious brands launch and scale with confidence. We build business and corporate websites, e-commerce and Shopify stores, WordPress websites, portfolios and landing pages, as well as custom web applications, mobile apps, Windows software and AI and payment integrations, each engineered to be secure, fast and easy to grow. After launch, our care plans keep them that way.

Every project is treated as a long-term digital asset rather than a one-off deliverable. That means clean foundations, careful attention to detail and clear communication from the first conversation to launch day.

Core Focus
- Secure, production-ready web and app solutions
- High-fidelity user experience and interface systems
- Scalable technical foundations for long-term growth

Process

## How we deliver a project

A clear, milestone-based process keeps every project predictable, whether it is a single landing page or a full online store.
- Step 1 Discovery We start with a clarity-first conversation about your goals, audience, content and constraints, so every recommendation is grounded in what your business actually needs before any scope is proposed.
- Step 2 Scope & Plan Discovery becomes a clear scope with aligned milestones, so you know what will be delivered, in what order, and when you will review progress.
- Step 3 Design Interfaces are shaped for clarity, conversion and brand consistency, with responsive layouts planned for phones, tablets and desktops from the start.
- Step 4 Build & Secure We engineer each site on a structured, scalable foundation. Security is embedded from architecture decisions to final QA, and performance is checked throughout rather than at the end.
- Step 5 Launch We launch with care, moving from pilot release to production, and keep you informed with transparent updates at every milestone.

Clients

## Who we work with

Our clients range from established companies to first-time founders. What they share is a need for a website that looks premium, works flawlessly and supports real business goals.
- Companies, startups and agencies that need a professional corporate presence
- Shops, clinics, factories and schools that want to be found and trusted online
- Brands selling online through custom e-commerce websites or Shopify stores
- Designers, photographers, developers and agencies who need a high-visual portfolio
- Marketing teams launching campaigns, apps, products and services with dedicated landing pages
- Teams that need custom web apps, mobile apps or desktop software to run their operations
- Businesses with a live website that needs ongoing care, better performance or a redesign

Where We Work

## Based in Cairo, working worldwide

Our studio is based in Cairo , Egypt , and we work remotely with clients in Canada, United States, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt .

We are available every day from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Cairo time, and we work in Arabic, English and German . When you book a meeting through our contact form, times are shown in Cairo time together with your local equivalent, so scheduling across time zones stays simple. Most inquiries receive a response within one business day.

Projects run fully remotely. Meetings are scheduled around your time zone, progress is shared at every milestone, and you keep one clear line of communication from kickoff to launch, whether your business is in Toronto, New York, Dubai, Riyadh, Kuwait City, Doha or Cairo.

Good to Know

## Questions about DevEraXTech

**Who founded DevEraXTech?**

DevEraXTech was founded in 2024 in Cairo, Egypt by Karim Ahmed, a full-stack MERN developer (karim.deveraxtech.com), and co-founder Loay Mohamed.

**What makes DevEraXTech different from other web studios?**

Security is built in from the first architecture decision rather than added at the end, every interface is designed to be pixel-perfect on every screen size, and each project is treated as a long-term digital asset with ongoing care plans available after launch.

**Do you work with startups or only established companies?**

Both. We work with startups launching a first product, growing businesses replacing an outdated site, and established companies that need custom software, integrations or a redesign.

**Do you work remotely with international clients?**

Yes. We are based in Cairo and work remotely with clients in Canada, the United States, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt, in Arabic, English or German.
